top_signals.title: AstraZeneca Is Said to Have Explored Bristol Myers Merger
top_signals.summary:
Bloomberg's Michelle Davis joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." AstraZeneca has explored an acquisition of Bristol-Myers Squibb, according to people familiar with the matter, in a potential megadeal that would rank as the largest ever in pharma.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
